description: Zeros of the Ramanujan entire function A_w: theta-limit Rouché localization ζ_n = w^{1−2n}(1+θ_n), |θ_n| ≤ 2κ(w)w^n for n ≥ n₀(w), n₀ explicit

A2_master_bound.verdict: L5 dominates |D_n/G| at every sample and is tight to within the reported factor — never loose by an exponential in 1/log(1/w)

A3_rouche_thresholds.certification: M1 and M2 are CLOSED-FORM majorants (no grid): M1 from the monotonicity of each Ω-factor in S = sin²(θ/2); M2 from factorwise perturbation around u = 1.  The evaluated grid suprema are reported only to exhibit the slack.
A3_rouche_thresholds.reading: n₀(w) is the explicit index from which the theorem applies.  It grows as w → 1 but is finite for every w < 1, and is modest at both substrate pins.

A4_certified_zeros.conclusion: ζ_n = w^{1−2n}(1 + θ_n), |θ_n| ≤ 2κ(w)w^n for every n ≥ n₀(w) — the theorem's own conclusion, ASSERTED here, not merely observed; θ_n = −κ(w)w^n + O(w^{3n}) is the measured refinement (rate → w per step of the residual/w^{2n} ratio)

A5_failure_map.naive_criterion: 2 Σ_{k≥1} w^{k²} < 1 at the geometric-mean radius ρ_n = √(r_{n−1}r_n).  Log-concavity of the terms with curvature ≥ 2ln(1/w) gives T_{n±k} ≤ T_n w^{k²}, so the single dominant term beats the rest only below this w₀ — and the dominance ratio → w as n → ∞, so it NEVER improves with n.  This is a scope-(a) statement about that argument, not about the result.
A5_failure_map.why_the_theta_route_works: L4's exact q-shift cancellation keeps the theta cancellation in numerator AND denominator, so the comparison is against |G(u)| pointwise rather than against Σ|terms|; the loss factor (w²;w²)_∞³ that kills the naive route never appears.
A5_failure_map.honest_residual: for n < n₀(w) the theorem is SILENT.  Nothing here excludes the asymptotic holding earlier — numerically it does — the condition is sufficient, not necessary.

summary.target: ζ_n = w^{1−2n}(1 + O(w^n)) for the zeros of A_w
summary.verdict: PROVED for every 0 < w < 1 and every n ≥ n₀(w), with the explicit constant 2κ(w), κ(w) = (w;w²)_∞²/[(1−w)(w²;w²)_∞²], and n₀(w) explicit from the closed-form majorants M1/M2 — computed here at both substrate pins
summary.residual: the theorem is silent for n < n₀(w); the refinement θ_n = −κ w^n + O(w^{3n}) is derived-and-measured, not separately proved; nothing is wired

q0AnchorReason: measures the A-W zero asymptotics over a w-ladder that includes BOTH substrate pins; the mu-vs-p spread is one of the reported quantities
